draft_note: Paste the object in `entries` into datasets/hadith-data/model_registry.json `entries` ONLY after a scoring run has actually produced outputs (today the account returns HTTP 402 and no model output exists). `kind` has no enum value for an audit; arabic_text_cleanup is the nearest, add an `extraction_audit` value to model_registry.schema.json if preferred. Fill the bracketed fields from output/run_manifest.json.

entries.model_id_note: Requested id as sent to OpenRouter (default of score_with_model.py). The response model is not stored per row; verify run_manifest.json before trusting this id.
entries.runtime: OpenRouter API (provider policy data_collection deny; temperature 0; reasoning disabled; no referer or title headers)
entries.work: Scores each extracted report of Musnad al-Rabi (rabi, 1,004), Musnad Zayd (zayd, 698) and Sahifat al-Rida (rida, 35) against a window of the OpenITI source, 0-3 for boundaries, cleanliness and sanad/matn split, with flags and verbatim-substring proposals (any proposal that is not a substring of the supplied window is discarded). Arabic only; no translation; no authenticity judgement.

date_range.start: [UTC date of the first completed request, from run_manifest.json started_utc]
date_range.end: [UTC date of the last completed request, from run_manifest.json finished_utc]
date_range.basis: run_manifest.json started_utc/finished_utc and the per-row request_started_utc/request_finished_utc

inputs: datasets/hadith-data/extraction-quality/output/records_with_windows.jsonl.gz (production text_ar, sanad, matn_ar and a normalised source window per record; 1,737 records)
datasets/hadith-data/extraction-quality/prompt.md (SHA-256 recorded in every row and in run_manifest.json)

outputs.unit: one verdict per record (status ok or failed)

outputs.note: model, prompt SHA-256, UTC start/finish, tokens, cost, stop reason

entries.review_state: machine_unreviewed; verdicts are advice to a curator. The deterministic audit (deterministic_checks.py) is the rule-based cross-check; disagreements between the two are the review queue.
allowed_uses: Ranking records for human review of extraction quality.
Candidate corrections that a curator accepts or rejects against the OpenITI source.
prohibited_uses: Writing any proposal into text_ar, sanad or matn_ar without a hash-bound human review.
Treating a score as a statement about the authenticity or grade of a report.

quality_findings.finding: Dry-run estimate for all 1,737 records at US$0.03/0.13 per million tokens: about 1.2 million input and 0.73 million output tokens, about US$0.13 (pessimistic 2.2 characters per token).
First live attempt (one batch of 4 records) returned HTTP 402 (account out of credit); the harness stopped cleanly with no output rows.

evidence.locator: whole file (run_id, model, prompt_sha256, started_utc, finished_utc, status, stopped_because)

entries.notes: Draft only. Remove draft_note when pasting.
